stepBody:
To prepare for a Data100 potluck, Oski wants to buy $$150$$ bananas.
$$1$$. He first filters the rows to those that have at least $$150$$ bananas in their inventory.
$$2$$. He then sorts the rows so that the visited store with the highest-priced bananas are at the top of the returned DataFrame.

You can assume that all banana prices are unique across the visited stores.##figure4.gif##
